# Atomic Chat

Use `atomic-chat/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "atomic-chat-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "atomic-chat/Meta-Llama-3_1-8B-Instruct-GGUF",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `ATOMIC_CHAT_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`http://127.0.0.1:1337/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `ATOMIC_CHAT_BASE_URL`.
